newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends slightly lower in modest trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended slightly weaker against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday in modest trade, reflecting minor demand for the greenback, dealers said.
The local unit was at T$27.609 against Tuesday's T$27.600 close, off an intraday low of T$27.615.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$209 million.

"The market was basically flat in the morning," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "Were it not for demand for the greenback from importers in the afternoon, the Taiwan dollar would have had no change."
Dealers said the local unit reflected the relatively quiet trend overseas with no sharp fluctuations in the absence of major market moving factors.
They expected narrow range in the near term.
A T$27.59-62 range was seen for Thursday.
